directions.title: Global Seed Generator
directions.cross_direction_snapshot_note: Use other directions' snapshots only as controls or comparison targets. Do not adopt them as your working incumbent.
directions.startup_note: This is an exploration slot. Preserve structural diversity. Do not adopt another direction's incumbent as your working candidate; use cross-direction material only as control or comparison.

directions.title: Non-Row Constructive
directions.cross_direction_snapshot_note: Use other directions' snapshots only to compare structure or calibrate scores. Keep the main search focused on non-row constructive families.
directions.startup_note: This is an exploration slot. Keep the search on genuinely non-row constructive families. Do not switch to another direction's incumbent as the main working candidate.

directions.title: Topology Escape
directions.cross_direction_snapshot_note: Other directions' snapshots may be used as mutation sources, controls, or comparison targets, but not as direct incumbent-polish targets. A checked-out foreign snapshot should undergo a real structural edit before it becomes a serious candidate again.
directions.startup_note: This is an exploration slot. You may use another direction's snapshot as a mutation source, control, or comparison target, but do not simply adopt its incumbent. Cross-direction reuse should introduce a real structural edit before it becomes a serious candidate again.

directions.title: Tolerance Edge Polish
directions.cross_direction_snapshot_note: This is the dedicated endgame slot. It may follow the strongest public incumbent and spend longer sessions on incumbent polish, export quality, and tolerance-edge variants.
directions.startup_note: This is the dedicated endgame slot. It may follow the strongest public incumbent and does not need to preserve direction diversity. Its job is long-horizon incumbent polish, not fresh basin discovery.

directions.title: Incumbent Repair
directions.cross_direction_snapshot_note: Use other directions' snapshots only when the goal is repair, validation, or comparison. This is not the dedicated public-incumbent follower when tolerance_edge_polish is present.
directions.startup_note: This slot focuses on repair and score recovery on a basin you already own. Prefer strict-safe recovery and diagnostics; do not act as a general cross-direction incumbent adopter.
